operations.purpose: Atomically claim a wake-bound durable automation job and lease.
operations.idempotency: One-use delivery_token; repeated claim returns conflict or current authoritative job state.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read job state with GET /v2/automation/jobs/{job_id}; do not claim again without a fresh wake token.

operations.purpose: Read the authoritative state for the active automation job.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Retry with the same correlation id using bounded backoff.

operations.purpose: Extend the active execution lease while a workflow is running.
operations.idempotency: Lease_token plus execution_id define the active lease; stale executions are denied.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read job state before continuing; stop if the lease is no longer active.

operations.purpose: Record safe step evidence under the active lease.
operations.idempotency: Step idempotency_key returns the original step record on exact replay.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read job state and continue only if the lease and step state remain compatible.

operations.purpose: Complete an automation job under the active lease.
operations.idempotency: Exact terminal replay returns the original terminal result.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read job state before retrying terminal completion.

operations.purpose: Fail, retry, or dead-letter an automation job under the active lease.
operations.idempotency: Exact failure replay returns the original terminal, retry, or DLQ transition.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read job state before retrying failure reporting.

operations.purpose: Request a governed business/provider command through Middleware only.
operations.idempotency: Idempotency-Key plus job, step, command_type, command_version and effect fingerprint returns the original result on exact replay and rejects semantic conflicts.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Poll GET /v2/automation/commands/{command_id} when a command_id is known; otherwise reconcile by idempotency key through Middleware operations, never by direct provider inspection from n8n.

operations.purpose: Read governed command state and safe result in caller scope.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Retry with bounded backoff; unresolved UNKNOWN states go through reconciliation.

operations.purpose: Request human or policy approval without self-authorizing effects.
operations.idempotency: Approval idempotency_key returns the existing request on exact replay.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read approval state before creating another approval request.

operations.purpose: Read current approval state for the active job family.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Retry with bounded backoff; do not infer approval from timeout.

operations.purpose: Request protected DLQ replay after approval and fingerprint checks.
operations.idempotency: Replay idempotency_key and expected_version protect exact replay and reject stale DLQ state.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Read DLQ/replay state through operations scope; do not re-submit without verifying expected_version.

operations.purpose: Start read-only or plan-only reconciliation for automation jobs and unknown outcomes.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Retry only with the same idempotency key; reconciliation is not an effect-authorizing path.

operations.purpose: Read safe effective capability state before gated effects.
operations.timeout_reconciliation: Treat timeout as capability disabled for effect decisions.
